Description: Founders must personally hire first 10 employees. Nobody can sell the vision + evaluate culture fit better than you. First hires define company DNA.
Do_This: Write job description yourself|Source on Twitter/LinkedIn/HN Who's Hiring|Do every interview personally|Sell the vision not just the role|Reference check every hire
Avoid_This: Delegating hiring before hire #10|Hiring agencies for early hires (expensive + misaligned)|Rushing to fill seats vs finding the right person

Description: Define core values FIRST then hire for them. Structured multi-round interviews with dedicated culture fit assessment. First 10-50 hires shape company culture permanently.
Do_This: Document 3-5 core values before first hire|Add culture interview round (separate from technical)|Ask behavioral questions not hypothetical|Involve existing team in culture assessment
Avoid_This: Hiring only for skills (ignoring values alignment)|Vague 'culture fit' as excuse for bias|Changing values to match who you can hire

Description: Remote is not a perk — it's an operating system. Async-first communication + clear documentation + intentional culture building. Access global talent pool.
Do_This: Define 'How We Work' document|Set core overlap hours for sync|Use Loom for async updates|Weekly all-hands + daily async standup|Document everything in Notion
Avoid_This: Treating remote as 'office but at home'|All-meeting culture across time zones|No documentation culture|Ignoring isolation and loneliness

Description: Create transparent compensation framework: salary bands + equity formula + benefits. Prevents resentment and enables fair scaling.
Do_This: Use Levels.fyi + Glassdoor for market data|Create salary bands per level|Formula-based equity (not negotiated)|Document and share internally|Review annually
Avoid_This: Ad-hoc compensation (negotiation-based)|Paying below market for equity promise|Different pay for same role without justification|Hiding compensation data

Description: First engineer sets technical DNA for years. Hire T-shaped generalist who ships fast. Look for side projects + GitHub activity + 'I built this' stories.
Do_This: Look for builders not optimizers|Check GitHub/side projects|Give take-home relevant to your domain|Hire for 0→1 skills not 1→N|Offer meaningful equity (1-5%)
Avoid_This: Hiring senior architect when you need builder|Over-indexing on FAANG background|Not giving meaningful equity|Hiring through agencies only

Description: Design structured hiring pipeline: sourcing → screen → technical → culture → offer. Use scorecards to reduce bias. Typical cycle: 2 weeks.
Do_This: Create role scorecard before posting|Structured questions (same for all candidates)|Take-home over whiteboard|2-week max timeline|Same-day feedback from interviewers
Avoid_This: Unstructured 'vibes-based' interviews|Month-long processes (you'll lose candidates)|No feedback loop from hiring data|Testing for knowledge not ability

Description: Hire contractors first then convert best performers to full-time. Lower risk + mutual evaluation period. 2-4 week paid trial project.
Do_This: Start with paid 2-week project|Clear deliverables + evaluation criteria|Both sides evaluate fit|Competitive contractor rate|Clear conversion path and timeline
Avoid_This: Unpaid trials (exploitative + illegal in many places)|Keeping contractors when you need full-time commitment|Not having IP assignment in contractor agreement

Description: 30-60-90 day onboarding plan. Day 1: can access everything and ship something small. Week 1: first meaningful contribution. Month 1: independent. Month 3: fully productive.
Do_This: Create onboarding checklist in Notion|Day 1 shipping (small task)|Assign onboarding buddy|Week 1/2/4 check-ins|Document all tribal knowledge
Avoid_This: Information overload on day 1|No onboarding plan ('figure it out')|No buddy or mentor|Expecting full productivity in week 1

Description: Quarterly lightweight reviews + weekly 1:1s. Focus on growth not judgment. Use OKR-style goals. No surprise feedback — bring up issues in real-time.
Do_This: Weekly 30-min 1:1s|Quarterly self-review + manager review|Focus on 2-3 growth areas|Calibration across team|Document and track progress
Avoid_This: Annual reviews only (too infrequent)|Stack ranking (toxic culture)|Surprise negative feedback in reviews|No written documentation

Description: Fire fast: if someone is wrong fit after coaching don't wait. PIP for performance. Immediate for values violations. Always treat with dignity.
Do_This: Documented performance conversations before PIP|30-day PIP with clear measurable goals|Mentor and support during PIP|Dignified exit process|2 weeks severance minimum
Avoid_This: Keeping poor performers too long (signals to team it's OK)|Firing without documentation|Public or humiliating termination|No PIP for performance issues

Description: Build diverse teams intentionally. Diverse teams make better products (especially for global markets). Address bias in hiring process.
Do_This: Blind resume screening|Diverse interview panels|Standardized evaluation criteria|Track demographics|Inclusive job descriptions (avoid gendered language)
Avoid_This: Tokenism (hiring for optics)|Lowering bar (instead lower bias)|Ignoring inclusion after diversity hiring|No data tracking

Description: Consistent team rituals keep teams aligned and connected. Weekly: planning + standup. Monthly: retro + demo day. Quarterly: offsite or team event.
Do_This: Weekly planning Monday + Friday wrap-up|Async daily standup (Slack/Notion)|Monthly retrospective|Quarterly team demo day|Annual planning offsite
Avoid_This: Too many meetings|No agenda for meetings|Skipping retros|All-hands without Q&A
